effect.fr: Tenu: Change Silvallié dans sa forme Psy.  Change le type de Coup Varia-Type en Psy.
effect.en: Held: Changes Silvally to its Psychic form.  Changes Multi-Attack’s type to Psychic.

flavor.en: A memory disc that contains Psychic-type data. It changes the type of the holder if held by a certain species of Pokémon.
